result.summary: The layout is generally clean and consistent, but the bottom navigation state contradicts the content being displayed: 'Profile' is highlighted as active while the screen shows the Home feed. A couple of minor cosmetic/contrast issues were also noted (low-contrast search placeholder and inconsistent favorite-button treatment between cards). Carousel clipping at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: The bottom tab bar highlights 'Profile' in green (active state) while the visible screen is clearly the Home/discovery feed (delivery address, search, categories, promo banner, restaurant lists). The 'Home' tab is rendered in the inactive gray state, so the navigation indicator does not match the current screen.
issues.suggestion: Sync the tab bar's selected state with the active route: highlight 'Home' (icon + label in brand green) and render 'Profile' in the default inactive gray.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray fill, giving a low contrast ratio that is hard to read in bright conditions.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (e.g., #6B7280 or darker) or lighten the field background so the text meets at least 4.5:1 contrast against its background.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently across the 'Popular right now' cards: the second card's heart sits on a visible dark circular scrim, while the first card's heart appears as a bare outline with no discernible backing, making the tap target look different and less affordant.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent dark circular background (with consistent size and padding) to the heart button on every card so it remains legible over any image and has a uniform 44px tap target.
